title: Routine & habits
note: V_THM-A1B1-08 routine A2 · quiz_mode sentence_gap · Use rewrite (underlined paraphrase + letter clue). bit cut 2026-09-02.
use_hint: Rewrite the sentence. Replace the underlined words.

intro.title: How often, how ordinary
intro.note: **everyday** (one word) = ordinary. **every day** (two words) = each day.
intro.note_cz: everyday = obyčejný. every day = každý den.

intro.title: already, yet, still
intro.note: Czech **už** is two English words: **already** in a + sentence, **yet** in − or ?.
intro.note_cz: už = already (v + větě), yet (v − a v otázce).

intro.title: You will use these words in

sentences.en: I have a bad habit: I play on my phone in bed.
sentences.cz: Mám špatný zvyk: v posteli hraju na telefonu.
accepts: I have a bad habit: I play on my phone in bed
I have a bad habit I play on my phone in bed

sentences.en: My father has a healthy lifestyle because he walks to work every day.
sentences.cz: Můj otec má zdravý životní styl, protože každý den chodí do práce pěšky.

sentences.en: I need a new schedule because I start work at eight now.

sentences.en: Look at the bus timetable before you go to the station.

sentences.en: I write my daily plan in the morning before I go to work.
sentences.cz: Ráno si píšu denní plán, než jdu do práce.
accepts: I write my daily plan in the morning before I go to work

sentences.en: An everyday problem at work is that the bus is late.

sentences.en: We have a regular meeting on Monday morning at work.

sentences.en: This is not the usual time — I usually get up at seven.
sentences.cz: To není obvyklý čas — obvykle vstávám v sedm.

This is not the usual time. I usually get up at seven
This is not the usual time I usually get up at seven

sentences.en: My brother is already at work when I get up.
sentences.cz: Můj bratr už je v práci, když vstávám.
accepts: My brother is already at work when I get up

sentences.en: The bus is not here yet, so I wait at the station.
sentences.cz: Autobus tu ještě není, takže čekám na nádraží.
accepts: The bus is not here yet, so I wait at the station
The bus isn't here yet, so I wait at the station

sentences.en: My mother is still at work at seven in the evening.
sentences.cz: Moje matka je v sedm večer stále v práci.
accepts: My mother is still at work at seven in the evening

sentences.en: I need my alarm because I get up at six every day.
sentences.cz: Potřebuji budík, protože každý den vstávám v šest.

sentences.en: I write in my diary every evening before I go to bed.
sentences.cz: Každý večer si píšu do deníku, než jdu spát.
accepts: I write in my diary every evening before I go to bed

sentences.en: I normally walk to work, but today I take the bus.
sentences.cz: Normálně chodím do práce pěšky, ale dnes jedu autobusem.

sentences.en: My morning routine is short: I get up, I eat, and I go to work.
